verdict.name: DATA INSUFFICIENT — uncertainties too wide for 3-sigma discrimination
verdict.explanation: Central-value pairwise separations show no alignment at strict 20-deg threshold (frac = 0%), BUT the literature observable uncertainties (Pantheon+ sigma ~30 deg, SDSS sigma ~30 deg) are too wide to reject alignment at 3-sigma confidence. CMB-vs-Hubble separation = 74.6 deg, combined sigma = 30.0 deg; (sep - 20 deg) / sigma = 1.82 sigma (below 3-sigma decisive threshold). Central values LEAN TOWARD C (NULL) but cannot conclusively reject A (PASS) at the prereg's 3-sigma criterion.
verdict.cascade_implication: D4-A034 cosmic row held PENDING tighter Hubble-flow / SDSS data. Surface to Grant for methodology adjudication: tighter Pantheon+ bulk-flow re-analysis from raw SN data, or independent LSS spin-orientation analysis, would tighten the 3-sigma test. E1c deferred until C5 settles.
